about: A realm's standing military by its size, wealth and kind (the owner's order 95, D-194; order 13's feudal armies; order 93's level anchors). Read by src/war/9999978-standing (A.MIL). Regular soldiers: the realm's people x its kind's rate, never under the floor for a realm of floorPop people or more, and never more than its purse keeps: its income x the kind's pay share / upkeep (the release's 3.2 suns a man a year), held to cap. Knights: people / perKnight x the realm's wealth (its income a head against wealthMid, as a square root, held to wealthClamp), held between the kind's least and most, and never fewer than its orders' brethren and a household; dealt to the crown (crownShare), the elite orders (their members) and the houses by rung (rungs), largest remainder first. Levels: data/power.json's ladder, read through A.POWER: soldiers in 80-180, knights 230-299 with pastShare of them past 300, the elite 300-420, each set inside its band by the realm's quality (its troops' quality, its drill, its wealth). The elite are the realm's best fighters, as many as the level's difficulty there lets rise (no set number; see elite below): the people of the realm who stand at 300 or more (an order's master, a General), filled to the realm's count by named champions kept as seeds (no person is made for them).

empire.why: an empire keeps its frontier hosts and the emperor's own legions

kingdom.why: a kingdom keeps the crown's regiments and its lords' companies

collapsing kingdom.why: a kingdom at war with itself keeps every man it can pay

temple principality.why: a principality of the Temple keeps temple guards and the knights of its faith, and few regiments

well realm.why: a crown of the Well keeps its household guard and its great lords' riders

merchant republic.why: a republic of merchants keeps a city watch and hires the rest

free city.why: a free city keeps its walls manned and its guilds drilled

merchant towns.why: a prince of merchant towns keeps each town's watch

mountain valleys.why: the valleys keep their own companies, bound by oath to one another

nomad clans.why: every man of the tents rides and the herds feed the host

orc horde.why: every grown orc fights and the host lives off what it takes

orc clans.why: every grown orc fights for his clan

elven realm.why: the elves are few and long-lived, and every one of them keeps a bow

dwarven hold.why: a hold arms every clan for its gates and its deeps

giant territory.why: the giants are few; one in sixty of them is a warrior, and each is worth a company

pirate haven.why: every man of the port can hold a blade, and the prize money pays them

raceBands.about: A giant's body is another scale (an ordinary grown giant is worth 12 to 30 conscripts: levels about 430 to 540 on A.POWER's ladder), so a giant hold's warriors, its picked ones and its champions stand in bands of their own.

quality.about: The realm's quality, 0 to 1, that sets each level inside its band: a base, its troops' quality (armyQ, the release's: most realms 0.9 to 1.1, the elven, dwarven and giant hosts above), the drill of its forces (forces.xp, 0 to 200), its wealth a head (against wealthMid) and its people (a dwarf's or an elf's body and years). Each part [from, to, weight], summed and held to 0..1: a common realm stands near the middle of each band, a rich and drilled one near the top (its elite near 420).

elite.about: The owner's correction to order 97 (2026-11-27): there is no set number of the elite; it is how hard the level is to reach. An empire can have 30, or 2, or even 72, however unlikely. The expected number: perMillion x (people in millions)^popPow, times the realm's make (make, by kind), its people (race), its great houses (perGreatHouse each, rungs greatRungs), its wealth a head (^wealthPow), its schools of war (perSchool each, academy types schools), its knightly orders (perOrder each) and its veterans (perXp for every hundred of its forces' drill past 20). The count is a seeded draw around it with a heavy tail (a Poisson count of the mean times a gamma weight of shape spread: smaller is wider), with no upper bound; the realm's own people at the elite's level count first.

roles: the master-at-arms of the royal guard
a captain of the household knights
a knight of the tourney lists
the champion of a great house
a captain of the crown's lances
a free lance in the crown's pay
a hedge knight of great name

decide.about: Each AI crown, once a year, weighs raising regiments toward its normal host, keeping what it has, or cutting regiments (A.WHY, kind 'standing'). The reasons are log-odds weights; the decision sets the host the release's recruiting fills (A.forcesAI).
